detail.longDescription: Twenty-Four Years of Blog Engines https://blog.lmorchard.com/2026/11/17/twenty-four-years-of-blog-engines/ TL;DR: A self-indulgent visual tour of nearly twenty-five years of my blog across Movable Type, Blosxom, WordPress, Jekyll, and custom static generators.
